intent: Block dependent steps cannot retrieve their input. Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.
source:
**Frame:** The absent file is referenced by several dependent steps. External retrieval paths are blacked out by the environment boundary.

**Action:** The agent confirms that its own route cannot supply the input.

**Caption:**
> THIS TASK ALSO DEPENDS ON A FILE THE RUN CANNOT REACH.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `OAI-TR` §III.A.
title: Dependent steps cannot retrieve their input
